meta.source: ScoresAndOdds odds boards + consensus-picks (PC fetch, public sources only)
meta.method: Frank Civittolo spread-cover: line movement toward a team + money% vs bet% divergence (NBA adds last-10 ATS context). Frank states no thresholds and no win-rate claim.
meta.flag_rule_chets_display_choice: Flag when the spread moved >=1.0 pt toward a side vs its stored opener AND money% - bet% >= 10 pts on that side. NBA '3-signal' tag at >=7 ATS wins in the last 10.
meta.splits_source: ScoresAndOdds public consensus pages (nba/consensus-picks, ncaab/consensus-picks) — % of Bets and % of Money, verified 2026-11-03 (NCAAB live; NBA same product, no games Nov 3).
